_help: The inventory window (official MapleStory art, UIInventory.img). x/y = the small window top-left in 1366x768 game pixels. w/h = the small window size (the art is 242x593). xExpanded/yExpanded/wExpanded/hExpanded = the wide window the + button opens (the art is 800x546). wide = 1 starts the wide window (0 = the small one). The rest is window-local, measured on the official art: titleH = the drag strip at the top. gridX/gridY = the first slot square, cellSize = the square, cellPitch = the step between the squares, cols/colsWide = the columns of the small and the wide window. itemDy = the icon's downward nudge inside the cell (the art's square sits 2px lower than the click rect). tabX/tabY = the first tab, tabW/tabH = the tab box, tabStep/tabWideW/tabWideStep = the tab row of the small and the wide window. countX/countY/countW/countH = the used/total field in the small window (the official pill holds only the slash; the numbers sit on each side), countWideX/countWideY/countWideW/countWideH = the same in the wide window. plusX/plusY/plusW/plusH = the + button (small window), minusX/minusY/minusW/minusH = the - button (wide window), closeX/closeY/closeW/closeH = the X, closeWideX = the X in the wide window. sortX/sortY/sortW/sortH = the sort button (small), sortWideX/sortWideY/sortWideW/sortWideH = the sort button (wide). coinX/coinY = the meso coin, mesoX/mesoY = the meso number (the number's right end), mesoWideX/mesoWideY = the same in the wide window. Keys may be omitted (keeps the default). tipTextW = the width the description wraps at (its inner layout comes from panel-stat.json: the detail pane of the stat window).
